item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi rtag bzlog mi mthun kun 'joms
item.coloph: de ltar bzlog (zlog) pa'i kha tshar rnam bzhi 'di/ phyi rabs don du pha nor bu la bzhag g.yung drung gsal sogs sgrub gshen rnams la gtad/ nam zhig bon la dar nub byung ba'i skabs/ mdo khams smad phyogs rin chen brag la sbas/ gter bdag srung ma rnams kyis bya ra ma g.yel gzobs// phyis su bdag 'dra gshen spral pas zangs brag rin chen 'bar ba'i mdun phyogs tsi ta 'dra ba'i brag la (nas) rnyed te (de) bka' rgya sdom(bsdoms /)phyis su hor sras mchog sogs grwa slob 'ga' nas bskul ngor / shog ser bod yig tu phab pa'o//

item.tib: tshe dbang drag 'khros kyi rtag bzlog mi mthun kun 'joms
item.coloph: de dag snyigs dus 'gro la phan pa'i phyir/ gu ru tshe dbang bdag gis sbyar ba yin/ bka' 'di g.yung drung gsal 'bar gnyed du gtad/ skabs zhig (shig) bon la dar nub byung ba'i tshe/ zhang zhung sgo mo rtse drug byang gi phyogs/ gcung po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs 'phro ba'i gnas/ zangs brag ri la gter sbas smon lam thob/ zhes gsung (gsungs) de bzhin lo tsa b+he ro yis/ brda' yig bris te lo tsa yis/ brda yig bris te gter sbas srung mar bcos (bcol//) phyis su bdag 'dra sems dpa'i ming brlams (rlom) gshen sprul pas/ phug leb 'o ma stag rtse'i/ brag dmar tsi rta 'dra ba'i ngos nas la cha'i sgrom bu zhig rnyed te (de/)lo mang gsang rgya gdab/ phyis su smon gsas (sras) rin po che'i thugs bzhed dang/ hor sras mchog gi bka' gsung cod pan spyir bor bcings te brda' yi yi ge 'ol tsam 'dug pa la spros te bod yig tu phab pa'o//
